about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: A professional property consultant and brokerage firm bridging housing gaps across Nigeria and the diaspora.
about.story:
TPI HOMES & PROPERTIES LIMITED [RC 6943025] is a real estate agency in Lagos, Nigeria. We specialize in providing top-tier real estate investments for maximum ROI.

We are a professional property consultant & brokerage firm with many years of experience in the Lagos real estate market. We bridge housing gaps and offer real-time solutions to clients across Nigeria and the diaspora.

We offer real estate services with world-class professionalism in the achievement of seamless transactions of legal interest in real estate between Developers, Owners and Sellers on one side, and Investors, Tenants and Buyers on the other.

With our versatile experience in the real estate sector covering various aspects of the profession, we are renowned for Real Estate Agency, Property Management & Development, Facility Management, and Real Estate Investment Consulting.
about.vision: Our VISION is to make land and home ownership a reality for all, because we believe everyone should own a landed property and that should not be a herculean task doing so.
about.mission: Our MISSION is to discover opportunities and implement cutting-edge strategies to deliver affordable, fast-developing lands to our customers, and expose them to avenues that take them steps closer to achieving their real estate goals.

values.title: Integrity
values.description: Clear documentation and honest pricing on every transaction. What we promise is what we deliver.

values.title: Professionalism
values.description: World-class standards backed by seasoned lawyers, surveyors and consultants.

values.title: Client First
values.description: Our clients' interests lead every recommendation we make, before, during and after the sale.

values.title: Excellence
values.description: We continually refine our process so acquiring property is seamless and stress-free.

about.founderBio: TPI Homes was founded by Olaitan Kolawole, a member of a reputable network of real estate marketing associations in Lagos, Nigeria — the Billionaire Realtors Group (BRG) amongst others — working alongside seasoned lawyers and surveyors. He holds a bachelor's degree in Accounting along with other certifications in the Real Estate and IT sectors. A multiple award-winning and passionate digital entrepreneur, he serves as a real estate investment consultant to clients across Nigeria and the diaspora.

services.title: Lands & Property Sales
services.summary: We specialize in the sale of land and houses. We offer flexible payment plans and incentives to make acquiring your property easier.
services.description:
Whether you are buying your first plot or expanding a portfolio, we match you with estates that fit your budget and investment horizon.

Every listing we present has been vetted for title validity and developer track record. We handle inspection scheduling, price negotiation, allocation follow-up and documentation, so you can invest with confidence from anywhere in the world.

highlights.title: Verified Titles
highlights.description: C of O, Governor's Consent and Excision documents confirmed before listing.

highlights.title: Flexible Payment
highlights.description: Spread payment across up to 12 months with transparent terms.

highlights.title: Free Inspection
highlights.description: Scheduled site inspections before you commit a single naira.

services.title: Real Estate Consultancy
services.summary: We draw on our vast and deep knowledge of the real estate industry in giving our clients guidance and advisory services.
services.description:
Our consultancy practice helps investors decide what to buy, where to buy, and when to exit.

We analyse infrastructure plans, developer credibility and comparable pricing across the corridors we cover, then translate that into a plan matched to your capital and risk appetite — whether you are buying to build, to hold, or to resell.

highlights.title: Market Analysis
highlights.description: Location-by-location appreciation data across Lagos and beyond.

highlights.title: Due Diligence
highlights.description: Title verification and developer background checks before you buy.

highlights.title: Portfolio Strategy
highlights.description: Entry and exit planning matched to your investment timeline.

services.title: Property Management
services.summary: We bring to bear our experience and expertise in the management of luxury and state-of-the-art property for sale or rent.
services.description:
Owning property should not become a second job. We manage residential and commercial assets end to end on behalf of local and diaspora owners.

Our team handles tenant sourcing and screening, rent collection and remittance, routine maintenance, statutory compliance and periodic condition reporting, so your asset stays occupied, compliant and well kept.

highlights.title: Tenant Management
highlights.description: Sourcing, screening and rent collection handled for you.

highlights.title: Facility Upkeep
highlights.description: Routine maintenance and repairs coordinated by our team.

highlights.title: Owner Reporting
highlights.description: Periodic statements and condition reports, wherever you live.

services.title: Property Request Service
services.summary: Can't find what you're looking for? Tell us your budget, preferred location and property type, and we'll source it for you.
services.description:
Our listings show a fraction of what we can access. Many of the best opportunities are off-market or released to our network before public launch.

Share your requirements — budget, location, property type and timeline — and our team will search our developer network and revert with matching options, including pre-launch pricing where available.

highlights.title: Off-Market Access
highlights.description: Opportunities released to our network before public launch.

highlights.title: Budget Matched
highlights.description: Options filtered to what you can realistically commit.

highlights.title: Fast Turnaround
highlights.description: We revert with matching options within a few working days.
